_comment: Off-balance-sheet items read from filing TEXT (lease, VIE, commitments, guarantees and equity-method notes), one record per item. XBRL-tagged items (RPO, purchase obligations, VIE maximum exposure, guarantees, equity-method investments) come from the automated feed and are not repeated here. Each record: ticker, item (leases_not_commenced | vie_unconsolidated | vie_consolidated | jv_equity_method_debt | spv | rvg | take_or_pay | guarantee | purchase_obligation | prepayment), amountUSDm (null when the filing gives none), basis (undiscounted | present_value | max_exposure | notional | carrying), asOf, filing {form, accn, url, section, page}, quote (the sentence the figure comes from), commence (for leases: from/to), counterparty, lookthrough {sharePct, amountUSDm, method} when a proportional view applies, accounting (ASC topic), tier T1, status needs_review | verified, verifiedBy, verifiedOn. Items may carry subsequent: true (signed after the balance-sheet date; never added to that date's totals), includedIn (already counted in another item) and note_en/note_es. Searched results: none (looked for and absent) or amount_not_disclosed (exists, no amount). Text-derived numbers stay needs_review until a second reading of the cited page confirms them (the automated second read or the owner). Oracle's items are read from the Oracle model's verified store (tools/oracle/data/obligations.json) by scripts/hyperscalers/build.mjs and are not duplicated here. reviewedBy: a person's sign-off (name and date); null until an analyst reviews the item. Verification = automated quote-match plus a second automated read, never an analyst review. build.mjs checks every quote against the harvested page of the cited accession (quoteCheck), links the main filing document and records its filed date; readBy/verifiedBy are internal provenance and are not emitted to the site.
